samples.question: START shows four tape cells numbered 1 to 4, with dark square = 1 and pale square = 0. The gold arrow marks the cursor. Read the ten command cards from left to right: red TOGGLE flips the cell under the cursor; blue NEXT moves the cursor one cell right, wrapping from cell 4 to cell 1; violet COPY writes the current cell's value into the next cell and leaves the cursor where it is. Apply every command to the current tape and cursor. After command 10, which final pattern do cells 1 to 4 show? Answer exactly one of: clear = 0000, front-pair = 1100, split-pair = 0011, alternating = 1010.
